description: TD announced a five-year financing commitment covering lending, underwriting and advisory activity. This is not a pledge to invest the full amount as the bank's own cash. The due date is the five-year anniversary of the announcement.
evidence: TD's September 14 announcement establishes the commitment; the Prime Minister's Office included it in the September 15 summit summary. Fulfillment remains pending.

promise: Aim to invest an additional C$10 billion in Canada by the end of 2027, subject to investment-return objectives.
description: The pension fund set a conditional investment objective, not an unconditional spending guarantee. Investments remain subject to its return requirements.
evidence: The fund's September 11 announcement states the amount, end-2027 horizon and return condition; Canada's summit release subsequently reported the commitment.
